facts.fact: Caboverde24, citing Cabo Verde Telecom, reports that three international submarine cable systems, WACS, EllaLink and SHARE, currently reach Praia, with direct routes to Lisbon, West Africa and Fortaleza (Brazil); all at Praia, so not independent.

note: CVTelecom says it wants to build a neutral, open interconnection platform; an ambition, not a stated open-access fact, so no access fact.
